answer: To enforce agent-native Sybil resistance, the protocol couples a zero-knowledge verifiable delay beacon with a superlinear slashing matrix applied to staking collateral. Consequently, an adversary fractionating capital across sub-identities faces an expected utility that becomes strictly negative as target volume expands across the network ocean. Because even a single sparrow identity clone triggers compounding economic penalties, subgame-perfect Nash equilibrium strictly stabilizes honest validation as the unique dominant strategy.
